author: David Bombal
description:
This is one of the utilities that I have found really useful. And the best part is that it is Open Source and Free!

Save time and make it easier to install Linux or other operating systems. Keep lots of ISO images on a single USB stick or flash drive rather than having one for each operating system. No need to use Rufus or Etcher. 

Note: There is currently an issue with Ventoy 1.1.11 and Ubuntu. More details on GitHub: https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/issues/3567
